scope: Final async route-aware hints on the real production build; six profiles, default single-worker capture. Nonhome public pages do not fetch home artwork; Home selects exactly its matching artwork pair; blocked optional helper falls back to real pictures. Existing accessibility/scroll/menu/private-route/motion checks remain. Eight expected profile skips, no retries or actual writes/provider sends. Software-WebGL readiness is observed before both original consecutive-frame comparisons.
